SASBDB entry SASDYM2  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDYM2/)

Publication: Prothrombin recognition and conformational modulation by anti-thrombin anticoagulant aptamers.
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ymthe.2026.07.042

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDYM2/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
